limits: Exclusive-state absence in this selected export is not ancient absence. A rectangle is a screening candidate, not equivalence or a semantic operator. Source-labelled sites and references are not an archaeological holdout.

protocol.component_identity: No equation between the added roof and standalone M134; only a candidate recurring graphic operation
protocol.coverage: All417 rows state whether visually selected, complete-field coverage, and matching-frame coverage; absent evidence never becomes a meaning. No global decipherment or code merger.
protocol.cross_root_comparison: Compare only pairs with different graphic-root labels. A shared frame is one observed for both pairs. Signed score is product of -1 for state1,+1 for state2,0 for state3. Report concordant plain, concordant roof, discordant and ambiguous counts, not just score.
protocol.frames: Entire exact prefix and suffix. Primary frame key additionally requires identical source site label, object type, length and position. Site labels are secondary/unverified. Unstratified full frames are diagnostic only.
protocol.missing_metadata: Null or empty site/type stored as <unknown>; an unknown/unknown match is not a verified shared site or type.
protocol.narrow_rectangle_criterion: Within a cross-root pair comparison require at least one shared frame exclusive plain/plain and a DIFFERENT shared frame exclusive roof/roof, with four distinct reference witnesses selectable. This is a corpus candidate requiring original-image/die checks; it is not semantic equivalence or a proved modifier. Counts of overlapping rectangles are not independent replications. The two frames must also share site/type/length/position within the stratified analyses; diagnostic frames still require identical length and position. This restriction was fixed before new counts.
protocol.null_scope: If eligible support exists, shuffle per-pair state masks only among its observed frames within exact source site/type/length/position strata, fixing coverage and mask multiplicities. 499 seeded replicates (20260927). Report movable slots and score variance. A degenerate null is uninformative; no semantic inference from a non-rejection. Exchangeability is a specified conditional null, not historical fact. Only frame-mask counts are preserved, not token/reference counts or object/formula dependencies. Record exact product of stratum multinomial allocation counts. No inferential modifier claim follows even from a nondegenerate score shuffle.
protocol.pre_count_correction: Before inspecting new context counts, crop-level review excluded M158/M159 because an extra central stroke also differs; no sole-roof operation. Six core pairs remain.
protocol.primary_corpus: strict_candidate true; exclude any token doubt/loss and empty strings; at least one other token in field
protocol.primary_endpoint: Number of rectangles with selectable four-distinct-reference witnesses. Signed agreement and its shuffle are secondary coverage diagnostics, not semantic tests.
protocol.question: Do independently visually selected roof additions exhibit recurrent matching base-versus-roof states in the same full textual frames across different graphic roots?
protocol.sensitivity_corpus: all complete undoubted exported fields, separately labelled because multiple-document coverage and original direction may be uncertain
protocol.states: For each pair/frame, 1=only base observed,2=only roof observed,3=both. All states and missing frames retained. State3 contributes zero to exclusive-state agreement and is reported, not recoded.
protocol.status: Prospective specification for this new statistic after prior corpus exposure; not a blind archaeological test
protocol.units: Deduplicate each pair/frame/state/reference. Repeated references do not add state weight. Preserve complete prefix/suffix and token position; no cross-field joining. Different reference numbers do not certify independent artifacts or dies.
